name: The Fairmont Vancouver Airport
positioning: Soundproofed Fairmont hotel at Vancouver International Airport (Fairmont Vancouver Airport), reached directly through the departures terminal
best_for: Travelers with a layover or an early flight who want to sleep quietly at the airport
Plane spotters who want runway and mountain views from the room

facts.text: The hotel can be reached directly through the airport's departures terminal.
Rooms are soundproofed and have views of the airport's active runways and the surrounding mountains.
Dining ranges from Pacific Northwest-inspired fare to craft cocktails with casual bites and traditional afternoon tea.
Fairmont Gold rooms include lounge access with complimentary breakfast and evening canapes, a private concierge, and YVR FasTrack access.
One Bedroom Suites are designed for families, with a separate living area with sofa bed and a large bedroom.
The hotel has a full-service spa and a health club with a pool and hot tub, and wellness amenities can be delivered to the room.

highlights.text: Globe@YVR has a Carry on Cuisine program that lets travelers take meals such as smoked British Columbian salmon aboard their aircraft.
Some floors are designated 'Quiet Zone' floors, kept silent during the day so tired travelers can rest.
Fairmont Gold rooms on the top floor come with in-room telescopes.
The in-house spa offers a pink grapefruit jet-lag recovery treatment.
Guests can borrow a BMW cruise bike to explore the city between layovers.

considerations.text: Parking at the hotel costs an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes the airport location limits local Vancouver exploration.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury airport hotels.

sources.title: Fairmont Vancouver Airport - Condé Nast Traveler
